biotools.summary: The Genomic SSR Millets Database (GSMDB) is a web-based resource providing comprehensive details on over 6.7 million Simple Sequence Repeats (SSRs) mined from the genomic sequences of seven millet species. It aims to facilitate millet cultivar advancement and related research, contributing to global food security.
